mentions.name: Manyou
mentions.description: A mobile app that acts as a museum companion: visitors take a photo of an exhibit and hear AI-generated narration about it, with the option to go deeper for more insightful, detailed narration. It is audio-first so users don't have to stare at their phone screen, using a highly knowledgeable AI and carefully chosen voices to recreate a documentary-style museum experience. It can also be tried outside a museum, though the narration is less relevant.
mentions.problem: The builder wanted to walk through a museum or gallery as if watching a documentary, which wasn't possible with existing options.
mentions.audience: Museum and gallery visitors, including people trying it outside a museum
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a mobile app that can be your museum companion. You take a photo and hear an AI-generated narration about the exhibit, you can learn more and hear more insightful and detail narration. It's an audio-first app so you don't have to stare at the phone screen
mentions.author: xicheng1
